fullContentHtml:
MPPSC Food Safety Officer FSO Final Result with Marks 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has released the final result for the post of Food Safety Officer. This recruitment was released for 67 posts. Applications for the MPPSC Food Safety Officer FSO Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 11 July 2025, to 10 August 2025. The written examination was held on 14 December 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for MPPSC Food Safety Officer FSO Final Result 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 11 July 2025
  • Last Date : 10 August2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 August 2025
  • Last Date Correction : 12 August 2025
  • Exam Date : 14 December 2025
  • Admit Card : 03 December 2025
  • Answer Key : 17 December 2025
  • Result : 21 January 2026
  • Final Result : 22 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 540/-
  • MP Reserve Category : Rs. 290/-
  • Portal Charges : Rs. 40/- (Included)
  • Correction Charges : Rs. 50/- (Extra)
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.

MPPSC Food Safety Officer FSO Final Result with Marks 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.
